evals.prompt: Building a B2B helpdesk SaaS. Each company has its own knowledge base articles and we want RAG search over them with pgvector. All companies in one Postgres. How should I set up the schema so one company never sees another's docs?
evals.expected_output: Schema with tenant_id + RLS ENABLE+FORCE + WITH CHECK, transaction-local set_config, composite FKs, app role not superuser/BYPASSRLS, hybrid search with RRF, RLS audit in CI and isolation tests.
